episode.episode: 7-15-26 - Hour 4 - If BYU defeats Notre Dame and Utah will they go 12-0 this season?
episode.showDescription: Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) keeps you up-to-date on all things BYU Sports. We not only cover football & basketball, but we dive into recruiting, baseball, soccer, and more. For insight that you can't get anywhere else, tune into 103.9/ 98.3 FM. Monday-Friday from 2-6 PM MST. Follow us on social media @espnthefan & interact with us using #ESPNTheFan.
episode.episodeDescription: Ben Criddle talks BYU sports every weekday from 2 to 6 pm. transcript_window.text: Georgia's down.
They shouldn't have won.
They dug themselves out of a hole.
And then Ohio State literally misses the field goal as the new year is turning over.
Yeah.
The clock hits midnight.
The kick goes wide left, and Georgia moves on and ultimately wins the national championship.
Awesome.
It's unbelievable.
Just iconic games, no doubt.
Obviously, the most recent, Arizona State, Texas.
I enjoyed that one.
The blowout, Indiana versus Oregon.
Thought it was going to be better.
Hoped would be better.
But Indiana, it was just on a tear.
They're playing the best football in college football, obviously.
And there was a disparity there of execution.
And I wouldn't say talent.
Oregon's one of the most talented, if not the most talented team in college football.
But disparity of execution and physicality, which that's why I love football.
11 on 11, meritocracy and execution sometimes trumps the talent on the football field.
Okay, key question, but probably final question unless something comes up here.
David, we appreciate you.
Is the route to making college football this celestial product, right?
